Create one new square textless illustrated card back for FOULWAKE, a 1721 sea voyage board game. Reference 1 is the visual-language anchor ONLY: bold living ink outlines, engraved directional hatching, tactile matte printed paper, stylized material weight. Do not include its captain, bird, lettering, frame or card layout. Reference 2 is the owner's lighthouse mood: lonely side elevation on weathered rock, dramatic sea scale; reinterpret freely, do not copy the photo or modern optics. Reference 3 is the exact family atmosphere for the sea: dull indigo-grey water with fine broken cream-grey ink, not shiny.
COMPOSITION: a double-ended playing-card composition with a large anonymous SIDE-VIEW stone lighthouse in the upper half and its upside-down 180-degree counterpart in the lower half. Each tower should be clearly read from the side, with full vertical masonry shaft, tiny narrow doorway and small simple roofed stone lantern at the top, firmly on a compact irregular dark rock ledge. Upper tower top about 7% down, rock foot about 45% down; leave a loose band of quiet dark ink water at the middle for a natural half-turn join. The lower counterpart rotates the whole upper scene, NOT a second unrelated building. Both halves have equal weight. No panel borders, no dividing line. This is a crafted two-ended engraved seascape, not an emblem or icon. Moody sea mist dissolves the distant space around the tower; NO straight sky horizon. Four edges retain the same quiet matte sea-blue value and fine broken water hatching as reference 3. Rock small enough that tower is unmistakably the subject at 70mm scale. Generous uninterrupted water at left and right; tower neither touches top edge nor central seam.
PERIOD: coarse 17th/early18th century masonry, simple soot-dark lantern opening; one subdued cream glimmer behind smoky panes, no coloured beacon. The upper structure is a simple sheltered oil/candle light, no Fresnel lens, no searchlight beam, no modern reflector, no electricity, no stripes, no brilliant halo. No specific working/abandoned/cache/false-light event clues, no damage, supplies, people, ships, flags or labels. Ink navy, stone grey, bone paper reserves, tiny restrained warm-neutral light. No photorealism, glossy rendering, saturated blue, ornamental ring, crest, compass, words, numerals, fake handwriting or watermark. Single completed square illustration only.
